sum: Gladstone Land Corporation is a publicly traded real estate investment trust that invests in farmland located in major agricultural markets in the U.S., which it leases to farmers. The Company currently owns 143 farms, comprised of approximately 98,000 acres in 14 different states and nearly 56,000 acre-feet of water assets in California. Gladstone Land Corporation was established in 1997 and was incorporated in Maryland.
ceo: Mr. David John Gladstone (Founder, Chairman, CEO & President)
